cardOverview.overviewText: A Doctors IMA card designed for medical professionals, providing lifestyle rewards, milestone perks, and added healthcare benefits.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Get Professional Indemnity Insurance, which covers up to Rs. 20 lakh per card and includes court awards, out-of-court settlement expenses, and reimbursement of legal and defense costs.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, immediately report the incident to SBI Customer Care at 1800 1234, 1800 2100, or 1800 112211. For email support, contact customercare@sbi.co.in
